title: Arm Interconnect Architect
summary: Customer-shipped desktop EDA software for configuring, visualizing, validating and building coherent and non-coherent interconnect designs.

dates.note: Current product involvement is directly confirmed in October 2026; exact project start and individual rotation dates remain unspecified.

facts.text: Developed Interconnect Architect, a desktop engineering application with an Angular/TypeScript frontend and Python backend for SoC interconnect configuration.
Shipped and maintained production Interconnect Architect software, implementing requirements from external Arm interconnect licensees and senior technical stakeholders.
Interconnect Architect has shipped externally for about six years and is released internally twice a month for interconnect, systems, RTL and test engineers.
Interconnect Architect has helped win Arm interconnect licensing business; Michael delivered extensive NoC/NCI tooling and owns its CMN GUI tooling.
Contributed to the Interconnect Architect Python backend API set.

notes: Product shipping history is not CMN-tooling tenure, Senior Software Engineer tenure, or sole authorship of the entire application.
No customer names, revenue, personal deal attribution, numerical commercial lift, or ownership of every release operation is established.
The supplied engineering analysis records identifiable contributions from November 2021 to October 2026, not the start of employment or necessarily first application work.
